pages.text: $(li)Self-sacrifice runes do not count toward the Digital Mob Agonizer’s ritual progress; only standard Sacrifice Runes are used.$(li)Mechanical Users cannot trigger Life Essence generation with the Dagger of Sacrifice—they only deal 1 HP of damage.
Use an Agonizer instead for automation.
$(li)How much Life Essence a mob gives depends on its type (aggressive, passive or villager) and its HP.
$(li)Early-game, automate blood iron bucket filling by piping fluids into an Ender IO tank, placing empty buckets inside, and using filtered conduits to shuttle full/empty buckets back and forth.
$(li)The Digital Mob Agonizer is a reliable Life Essence source for crafting altars. Woot-based mob farms may yield extra drops but add complexity.
